name: DeviceHub Mask
subtitle: Native headless remote client for DeviceHub Mask.
description: Control iOS devices through a DeviceHub Mask headless server with native HTTP, WebSocket, HEVC, PCM audio, Bonjour discovery, and multi-touch support.

apps.name: DeviceHub Mask
apps.subtitle: Headless remote connection client.
apps.versionDescription: Unsigned IPA generated by GitHub Actions. SideStore or AltStore signs it during installation.
apps.localizedDescription: Connect to and control devices exposed by a DeviceHub Mask headless server.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Used to discover and connect to DeviceHub Mask servers on the local network.
